S08 E16 — Pups Stop a Super Shaker; Pups Save a Flying Farmhouse
Farmer Al's harvest machine goes haywire and shakes up Adventure Bay, even threatening to rock the Lookout off its foundation; Farmer Al has a wild dream that the PAW Patrol must rescue him and Yumi when his animals start acting like humans.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S12 E08 — Pups Stop a Topiary Tal; Pups Save a Hum-Ball
Mr. Park has a Chickaletta topiary, but when Digi and Tal try to help, things get worse; Humdinger creates havoc with a moose and geyser as he tours Yellowbone Park in his rolling Hum-Ball.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E24 — Pups Save a Giant Plant; Pups Get Stuck
Mayor Goodway's gesture of goodwill gift grows out of control when it is planted in the wrong place; Marshall's fire truck becomes mysteriously magnetized.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E05 — Pups Save a Sleepover; Pups Save the Carnival
Farmer Al's animals go missing during a sleepover; Cornelius escapes from the pig ride at the carnival, and all the prizes have gone missing too.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E03 — Pups Save a Melon Festival; Pups Save a Cow
Mayor Humdinger's plan to win the giant melon contest goes off the rails when his "melon" bounces away and causes chaos all over town; Farmer Al's truck gets stuck on a broken bridge.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
Best of Sea Patrol
A baby octopus gets separated from its mother; Humdinger makes a robotic shark to scare everyone; the pier has a broken support post; Carlos and Tracker become stranded on an island; Cap'n Turbot's boat gets frozen in the Arctic ice.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S13 E11 — Pups and the Digi Tal Safety Suit; Pups Put a Mouse on the Move
After Danny's baseball accident, Digi and Tal create a safety suit for him to wear, designed to protect him from danger; Francois' fancy fromage goes missing before the competition, so he enlists Squeak the mouse to lead the rescue.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E03 — Cat Pack/PAW Patrol Rescue: Rocket Rescuers; Cat Pack/PAW Patrol Rescue: The Golden Lion Mask
Cat-Pack members Wild and Shade team up with the Mighty Pups to stop a runaway rocket; when the Ruff-Ruff Pack swipes a priceless golden lion mask from the museum, Shade and Wild must help the PAW Patrol to retrieve the stolen artifact.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E23 — Pups Save Luke Stars; Pups Save Chicken Day
When Luke Stars gets stuck on a ledge, Ryder and Marshall rush to the rescue; Mayor Goodway's big plans for Chicken Day become threatened when the Chicken of Honor, Chickaletta, mysteriously disappears.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E15 — Pups vs. the Robo-Ducky; Pups Save the Lost Penguin
Digi and Tal build a big Robo-Ducky that runs amok through Adventure Bay; when Mayor Goodway tries to catch a glimpse of a migrating penguin colony, her precious Chickaletta and a Baby Penguin accidentally switch places.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E05 — Pups Save the Mustache; Pups Save the Funhouse
The Pups must help to find Mayor Humdinger's mustache after he accidentally shaves it off; after a carnival train gets stuck in a tunnel, it results in a mountainside funhouse-style wild ride.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E24 — Pups Save a Jukebox; Pups Save a Mayor on a Wire
Mayor Humdinger steals a jukebox so he can play an annoying song all day long, but Chase and Rubble track it down to save the records; a hungry eagle causes Mayor Goodway's tightrope walking lesson to go awry, sending her down Jake's Mountain.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E07 — Mission PAW: Royally Spooked!; Pups Save Monkey-Dinger
The pups go to Barkingburg to investigate when the Princess thinks she has seen a ghost; while on safari with Carlos and Tracker, Mayor Humdinger steals a magic mask.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E17 — Pups Save a Space Rock; Pups Save a Good Mayor
Everest, the Turbots and a Space Rock get trapped in a cave; when Mayor Goodway goes missing, Mayor Humdinger causes havoc in Adventure Bay.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E26 — Pups Save Their Floating Friends; Pups Save a Satellite
Ryder and the pups must repair the aliens' spaceship and get everyone back to Earth; when a satellite begins to fall toward Adventure Bay, the PAW Patrol have to fix it before it crashes.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E20 — Pups Save the Mail; Pups Save a Frog Mayor
When the postman's truck gets stuck in the mud, the mail is stuck in a tree; Mayor Goodway turns into a frog.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E01 — Call a Clambulance
Oona's friend must visit a doctor when he breaks a bone in his tail.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E16 — Party at Sea!
The Guppies must use their nautical knowledge to save their party at sea when a giant ball of snow cone ice threatens to sink the party ship.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E09 — Super Baby!
When supervillain Lady Goo Goo starts changing everyone into babies, it's up to Guppy Girl and Bubble Boy to stop her before they get turned into babies too!

title: Team Umizoomi
description:
S03 E14 — Doctor Bot
When Mike falls off his scooter and scrapes his knee, Dr. Bot and the team come to his rescue.

title: Team Umizoomi
description:
S04 E20 — Umi Rescue Copter
The team gets a distress call from way out in the ocean when Danny the Dolphin hurts his tail and is unable to swim.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E03 — Pups Save a Playful Dragon; Pups Save the Critters
Buddy, the playful dragon from one of Alex's books, gets out and the pups need to get him back; Francois' trailer comes unhooked and all of his critters get loose.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E02 — Pups Save Big Paw; Pups Save a Hum-Mover
When an ancient relic goes missing from Carlos' archaeological dig, Tracker and Skye must track down the creature that may have taken it; Mayor Humdinger pretends to break his toe to win a race.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E10 — Pups Save a Talent Show; Pups Save the Corn Roast
The Pups help out the mayor in the Adventure Bay Talent Show; when Chickaletta gets trapped in a corn field maze, the PAW Patrol must come to the rescue.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S02 E15 — The Crew Builds an Indoor Skydiving Center; The Crew Builds a Roller Rink
Mayor Greatway and Mr. Ducky-Doo want to show their skydiving skills; when wind gets in the way, the pups help them skydive on the ground; when Wheeler and Truffles the pig can't ice skate, the crew finds a construction.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S01 E21 — The Crew Builds a Giant Lemonade Stand; The Crew Builds a Wildlife Bridge
After the crew builds a special lemonade stand for Lucas and Lily, a sour Speed Meister sends it rolling through Builder Cove; Rubble & Crew build a bridge to help Crunchy the beaver cross the road.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E15 — Pups Save a Friend; Pups Save a Stowaway
When Marshall begins to feel like his clumsy ways are ruining his friends' fun, he decides to take a break from the PAW Patrol and goes off to the woods; Cali becomes an unsuspecting stowaway when she is accidentally packed up into the Paw Patroller.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E11 — Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Royal Kitties
When the Royal Kitties are kidnapped on their way to Adventure Bay for a special visit, Ryder needs all the pups to help Chase investigate the case.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E25 — Pups Take in a Runaway Kitty!; Pups Save the Cheese Goat!
When Rocky Kitty runs away and tries to join the "PAW Patrol," he helps the pups rescue Humdinger and the kitties from a hang-glider ride; when the Good Neighbor Robots confuse Farmer Al's request, they wind up being the target of a hungry eagle.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E09 — Mighty Pups, Super Paws: When Super Kitties Attack
When the Kitty Catastrophe crew gets superpowers, the little kittens cause big problems all over town.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E07 — Pups Save the Hiding Elephants; Pups Save a Yodeler
Elephants become trapped in the Monkey Temple after a bee frightens them away from their watering hole; Wingnut runs away from wolves that are attracted to his yodeling and he ends up trapped in a canyon.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E14 — Pups vs. Ouchy Paws; Pups Save a Glow-in-the-Dark Party
Sid Swashbuckle pretends to be a legendary ghost so that he can take Danny's new skateboard; Ryder and the Pups race to save Mayor Goodway's Glow-in-the-Dark Party.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E13 — The Unidentified Flying Orchestra!
After Gil and Molly meet a conductor, the Guppies want to join an orchestra.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E04 — The Super Ballet Bowl!
Molly and the Guppies want to learn how to tell a story through dance.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E19 — Fogzilla!
It's lighthouse keeper Deema's birthday, but when a monster named Fogzilla keeps blowing out her lighthouse, she needs to figure out how to get Capt. Molly's ship, carrying her birthday cake to shore, or there won't be a party.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E17 — Bubble Scrubbies!
The Guppies perform a "soap opera" to teach Mr. Grouper about good hygiene.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E17 — It's a Lizard!
When showman Gil's real live dragon (actually a Komodo dragon) gets loose in the small town of Bubbleville, it's up to Pet Finders Oona and Zooli to track the lizard down and return it to its home on Komodo Island.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E02 — The Crayon Prix
The Bubble Guppies learn about colors while car racing.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E20 — Bigfoot Crossing!
On the hottest day of the year, Rangers Goby and Gil's job is to make sure pedestrians reach the lake safely; however, Bigfoot causes issues when he removes the stop signs from the park.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E18 — Sir Nonny the Nice!
Nonny is on a quest to become a real knight.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E03 — Bubble Puppy!
The Bubble Guppies learn how to care for pets when Gil wants to adopt a puppy.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E25 — Escape From Volcano Island!
Skipper Molly and First Mate Gil are shipwrecked on Volcano Island, and it's about to erupt; parts of their boat start to mysteriously disappear.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E07 — Genie in a Bubble!
When Nonny, Gil and Zooli conjure a genie, she agrees to grant a wish to whoever brings her the most precious gift.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E13 — Too Bright for Movie Night!
If the Moon People can find a way to make it dark during the day, the Sun People agree to turn off their giant night light so the Moon People can enjoy their movie night.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E10 — The Jaw-some Sharkventure!
Zooli and her crew of marine biologists escort their new friends Baby Shark and his pilot fish, William, to visit Baby Shark's great-great-great-great-great Uncle Slow Mo and help them escape the determined fisherman who's chasing them.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E04 — Guppy Movers!
When their friend's moving day does not go as planned, Molly, Gil and the Guppy Movers head out to set things right in his new home.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Parachute Games; Flying Discs; Kiddie Workout; Monkey Trees; Trampoline
Peppa has fun playing parachute games at playgroup; Peppa learns how to throw and catch flying discs in the park; Mr. Potato leads the playgroup in a fun musical workout; Peppa visits an adventure park; Peppa has fun at a trampoline park.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Children's Festival; Muddy Festival; World Book Day; Roman Day; Foggy Day
Peppa and her family go to the children's festival; World Book Day at playgroup; Peppa has fun dressing up; Peppa and her family get lost in the fog.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Spring; Miss Rabbit's Helicopter; Baby Alexander; Grampy Rabbit's Lighthouse; Miss Rabbit's Day Off
Grandpa Pig organizes an egg hunt; Miss Rabbit takes Peppa's family for a ride; Peppa's cousin visits; Grandpa Pig takes everyone to visit the lighthouse; Miss Rabbit hurts her ankle.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Peppa Goes to Paris; Grandpa Pig's Pond; Once Upon a Time; Super Potato; Playgroup Star
Peppa and family go on a trip to Paris to meet Delphine Donkey and her family; the Donkey family take Peppa and family to the top of the Eiffel Tower, forcing Daddy Pig to face his fear of heights.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S13 E03 — Pups Save the Alien Grandpa; Pups Save a Lemon-Loving Ducklin
Cap'n Turbot speaks fluent alien while stranded with an Alien Grandpa; a lemon-loving duckling from Yumi's Farm disrupts a delivery to Lizzy's Lemonade Shoppe.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E05 — Pups Save a Ghost; Pups Save a Show
When a ghost appears at the Lookout, the Pups and Chase have a stakeout; the Pups put on a Medieval play in the town square.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S06 E601 — The Crew Builds a Giant Halloween Pumpkin
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play and build whatever the community needs.
